## SecretAccessFailure Enum

A secret provider's diagnosis of a failed local key read\.

```csharp
public enum SecretAccessFailure
```
### Fields

<a name='Meshline.Interactions.SecretAccessFailure.Unknown'></a>

`Unknown` 0

The cause is unknown; the SDK must not replace or delete the key\.

<a name='Meshline.Interactions.SecretAccessFailure.TemporarilyUnavailable'></a>

`TemporarilyUnavailable` 1

Access can return, for example after unlocking the platform keystore\.

<a name='Meshline.Interactions.SecretAccessFailure.PermanentlyLost'></a>

`PermanentlyLost` 2

The provider has positively established that the original key cannot be recovered\. This diagnosis does not authorize automatic replacement or deletion\.
